item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i dbang 'bum las / rig pa brjid dang ldan pa'i phyir / rig 'dzin sku gsung thugs gsum gyis / rang grol gzungs kyi yi ge 'di 'od ldan 'bar mas bkod pa
item.note: the final text in this section mkha'-'gro 'od-ldan 'bar-ma requested from dran-pa nam-mkha' and other rig 'dzin.
